activity_summary: You looked back at the bench in the dusk. The foul sheets were still under the stone, and the inkhorn was still in the knot-hole. The apples were dark. No one was in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked from the house, and did not go back to the bench.

entities.name: the orchard bench
entities.context: Mentioned in The stone on the foul sheet

facets.activity: Looked back at the foul sheets under the stone
